_about: Compute used after the paper's submission, by hardware, derived from cluster accounting, cloud billing and the runs' own records (not released: they name hosts, accounts and runs).

slurm_h100.definition: H100 80GB GPU-hours of every job (failed and abandoned included), MIG slices at their share of an H100 (1g.10gb = 1/7)

cloud_tpu.definition: billed accelerator chip-hours and list price (before credits) of every node, by day

rtx4090.definition: the union of the busy intervals the runs recorded themselves (learned-policy runs and trials, evaluation results); work without such a record is not counted

device_sampler.definition: an nvidia-smi log of the GPU every 5 s: allocated = a process held over 100 MiB, active = a kernel ran; every use of the machine, recorded or not
